name: environment_test_scn2
description: Explicit static development scenario 2; adapted from the reconstructed debug config. Not an original teammate preset. The anchored scenarios, one episode per scenario of the file that CausalDiagnosis/frameworks/AssetOpsBench/scenarios/download_scenarios.py fetches into the data folder of the asset, anchored at the scenario's date under the assumption that hyd_1 is hp_1 with one recorded cycle per day from 2022-07-01, with the recorded condition of that day hidden and the scenario text as the question. The driver fills start and question per scenario from CausalDiagnosis/frameworks/AssetOpsBench/scenarios/scenario_anchors.py. The big layers are those of static.json, and the fault rule admits any number of faulty components, since an anchored day is not drawn under a rule.
